mapper.insert: insert into xl_semester_plan (user_id, name, start_date, end_date, memo, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{name}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{memo}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update xl_semester_plan set name=#{name}, start_date=#{startDate}, end_date=#{endDate}, memo=#{memo}, update_time=now() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from xl_semester_plan where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: select id, user_id, name, start_date, end_date, memo, create_time, update_time from xl_semester_plan where id=#{id}
select id, user_id, name, start_date, end_date, memo, create_time, update_time from xl_semester_plan where user_id=#{userId} order by start_date desc
